decisions.reason: The J_BAT short-edge placement is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY under this Requirement.
The source specifies mechanical constraints for the integrated single-board design, not the earlier modular main-board layout.
The integrated-board connector and antenna constraints do not modify the separate sensor-board mechanical layout.
Although both designs place USB-C on a short edge, the source applies to the integrated board and does not change the earlier modular power-board layout.
The antenna orientation and keepout are mechanical-layout constraints and do not change the ESP32 module selection or full-pin breakout requirement.
Grouping the I2C display connector with other display connectors does not change pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or other I2C electrical requirements.
Battery and USB connector placement does not alter the AXP2101 electrical power-path topology or charging behavior.
The enclosure already must fit the finalized board orientation and connector layout; the listed board constraints do not change that enclosure requirement.
The source establishes component-placement constraints but does not change BOM entries, part numbers, population choices, or manufacturing documentation.
Display-connector grouping changes mechanical placement only and leaves the sensor-board connector inventory, pinouts, and module interfaces unchanged.
Placing USB-C on a user-facing short edge does not change the standalone regulator, activation condition, powered load, or source-selection behavior.
The mechanical placement constraints do not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.
